content.title: Dollar Retreats From Haven Gains After Weak Manufacturing Data
content.summary: The Bloomberg Dollar Spot Index fell about 0.1% as of 4:00 p.m. in New York.  Earlier, the measure advanced to its strongest mark since Dec. 22 following the US action against Venezuela, prompting investors to consider the fallout to currencies linked to global oil and commodity markets.  The Mexican peso fell in the immediate aftermath but recovered in later trading.
